pair.title: Securely connect the Rotaryknob
pair.description: Select both processors belonging to the same Rotaryknob. PassionWave generates an individual key for each processor and configures ESPHome without manual key entry.

connection.title: Set up PassionWave Rotaryknob
connection.description: Assign this Rotaryknob display and bridge plus Music Assistant. Every assignment can be changed later from Configure on the PassionWave entry.

lights.title: Arrange lights on the Rotaryknob
lights.description: Choose the four positions in the order shown on the display. “Not assigned” leaves a position empty. Names are copied automatically from Home Assistant.

library.title: Configure visible media
library.description: All entries are shown automatically by default. Remove “All automatically” and select individual entries to limit the display. An empty selection hides that category.

error.endpoints_not_found: S3 and Bridge were not both found on the network. Check Wi-Fi and reopen setup.
error.endpoint_unavailable: At least one selected processor is no longer reachable. Reopen setup.
error.provisioning_window_closed: The secure setup window has expired. Power the Rotaryknob off and on, then restart setup within 20 minutes.
error.pairing_failed: Secure pairing could not be completed. Verify that both processors are online and try again.
error.invalid_s3_device: The selected display does not provide the required PassionWave target entities.
error.invalid_bridge_registration_entity: The selected entity is not the PassionWave registration entity of an ESPHome bridge.
error.library_unavailable: The Music Assistant library could not be loaded. You can continue with “All automatically” and open the selection again later.

abort.already_configured: This PassionWave Rotaryknob is already configured.
abort.bridge_transport: The Bridge is configured automatically behind the PassionWave component.
abort.pairing_complete: S3 and Bridge are now securely connected to ESPHome. Reopen PassionWave after a few seconds to assign Music Assistant.

error.invalid_s3_device: The selected display does not provide the required PassionWave target entities.
error.invalid_bridge_registration_entity: The selected entity is not the PassionWave registration entity of an ESPHome bridge.
error.library_unavailable: The Music Assistant library could not be loaded. You can continue with “All automatically” and open the selection again later.

init.title: Configure PassionWave
init.description: Change this Rotaryknob assignment. The next step contains its four light positions, followed by optional media filters.

lights.title: Change light positions
lights.description: The order matches this Rotaryknob display. Names are copied from Home Assistant again after saving.

library.title: Configure visible media
library.description: “All automatically” follows the complete Music Assistant library. Without it, only selected entries are shown; an empty selection hides the category.
